admission_policy: A constant is admitted only when it is a standard, long-established definitional or physiological reference value rather than a current clinical recommendation. Recommendations, thresholds and intervals that change with guidance are NOT admitted here; they belong in a dated evidence packet with a cited source. Every constant records the definition it encodes so that a reader can check it without trusting this file.

constants.definition: The classical description places the landmark one third of the way along the line running from the anterior superior iliac spine to the umbilicus.

subject_terms: anterior superior iliac spine to the umbilicus
constants.definition: The whole line between the anterior superior iliac spine and the umbilicus in an adult.
A term pregnancy is dated from the last menstrual period and completes at forty weeks.
